_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores, online, and through their mobile devices'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, e-commerce retail or through a combination of both areas), which could adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2014 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores, online, and through their mobile devices'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, e-commerce retail or through a combination of both areas), which could adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2014 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.50x; +12% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.42; conservative 2yr +11%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.0%/yr (FY15 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.5%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +11.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2014-05-16) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.50x (15.6% downside to Bear $65 / +31.2% upside to Bull $101) | Adj composite 1.60 vs market 3.02: gap -1.42 [OVERVALUED] | +12% above the EPP floor $69 (13x FY15E $5.28) | Conservative 2-yr case: +10.8% total (+5.4%/yr) | At 14.6x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $102 sits above the BULL case; U.S. comps -0.2% in Q1 FY15, forward sales +3-5% (FY15 net sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
